en: A vintage black-and-white panoramic view of a European city with a wooded hill rising steeply in the center-left. On top of the hill there are fortifications and buildings, while at its base and along a river to the right stretch dense city blocks, bridges, churches, and multi‑story buildings. The title text at the top left reads in German. The overall style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.
